name: Limitless Native Ports
description: Nuvio-native ports maintained directly by Limitless.

scrapers.name: CineStream
scrapers.description: Clean Nuvio-native CineStream core using a small sequential set of HTTPS sources (Hexa, VidFast, VidCore). CineSimkl/CineTmdb metadata frontends and torrent sources are intentionally omitted.
scrapers.author: Limitless clean-room port based on CSX CineStream behavior

scrapers.name: JPFilms
scrapers.description: Japanese movies and TV from JPFilms, focused on Japanese-language content with English-subtitled releases.
scrapers.author: Limitless port based on cs-Karma JPFilms

scrapers.name: OneTouchTV
scrapers.description: Asian drama provider with Korean, Chinese, and Japanese coverage plus subtitle tracks when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless port based on the OneTouchTV implementations used by CloudStream/YaStream

scrapers.name: WCoflix
scrapers.description: Anime and cartoons from WCOForever/WCOfilx with explicit English DUB and Japanese SUB labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless port based on cs-Karma / CloudStream MegaRepo
